messages:
Jen (CEO): Follow-up thread from the all-hands about the org changes. I'm going to answer the most common hiring/structure questions here. Please keep it short so we can pin answers.
Leah (People Ops): TL;DR: no layoffs; shifting hiring priority toward infra, security, and compliance for Q2/Q3. This is to support Dedicated/Private growth.
Marcus (Head of Eng): To be clear: product roadmaps are reprioritized, not cancelled. Some feature teams will see hiring pauses while infra/SRE ramps get front-loaded.
Lina (SWE): What does "front-loaded" mean for my team We had two open backend hires.
Elena (Talent Partner): Actionable: teams get a 5-business-day window to propose internal redeploys for any paused req. After that, roles go to the internal job board then external.
Omar (Recruiter): For any urgent infra reqs, we can fast-track interviews (2-week SLA). Flag candidates with "infra-priority" in Greenhouse.
Ravi (VP Product): Customers in EMEA/APAC with Dedicated commitments are protected; we will prioritize hires needed to meet those SLAs and regional support.
Leah (People Ops): We will publish the full headcount spreadsheet this afternoon (function buckets + flagged roles). Also adding a column for "redeploy suggested" and "impact rationale."
Lina (SWE): Is there compensation or retention support for folks asked to move teams?
Jen (CEO): Yes. We will offer relocation/retention stipends in cases where moving teams improves time-to-delivery for critical work. Not automatic; case-by-case.
Elena (Talent Partner): If your role is flagged, Talent will reach out with options: redeploy, backfill, or timeline pause. Expect outreach within 72 hours.
Marcus (Head of Eng): Manager hiring: we're pausing most new people-manager searches unless the role unlocks headcount scalability or infra reliability.
Lina (SWE): Any change to promotion cycles or IC/manager paths?
Leah (People Ops): Promotion cycles remain. We still encourage IC->manager transitions. We'll prioritize internal candidates for new openings.
Omar (Recruiter): For external candidates already in process  we'll finish interviews for roles that remain open. For paused roles, we'll keep candidates warm and update timelines.
Ravi (VP Product): Roadmap note: a handful of low-revenue experiments will be pushed to Q4; core platform and security work stay on track.
PeopleOpsBot: Doc uploaded: https://go.redwood/hiring-update (Headcount by function, redeploy guidance, Q&A)
Leah (People Ops): Office hours Friday 10am PT to walk through the spreadsheet. Bring specific role questions; we'll triage them live.
Lina (SWE): If my team loses a headcount, what happens to our oncall load?
Marcus (Head of Eng): We'll coordinate oncall adjustments with eng-sre. Expect temporary rota changes and some cross-team support until roles are redeployed.
Jen (CEO): Key message: this is prioritization to keep the business healthy and fund growth areas. We'll be transparent and offer concrete redeploy options first.
Elena (Talent Partner): If you want to advocate for a paused role, DM me + your manager with one sentence why it's mission critical and one metric to measure success.
Lina (SWE): Thanks, appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:
Leah (People Ops): Final note: no immediate hiring freeze on everything. We're asking teams to delay non-critical external offers where possible. We'll update the people handbook with the rubric used for decisions (impact, SLA risk, legal exposure, revenue, and time-to-value).
Jen (CEO): We'll post updated slide deck and the archived version by EOD. Thanks for the questions. Reactions are fine for quick ack so we don't spam replies. :sparkles:
